description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for updating a catalog item in an e-commerce application. It includes route setup, request handling, data validation, and response construction.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint to handle updating catalog items via HTTP PUT, including route configuration and request processing.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the API route for updating catalog items, applying authorization and linking to the request handler.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the update request by fetching the existing item, updating its details, saving changes, and returning the updated data.
